why_not_pass: The matrix records what each tree declares and what was actually run. Most cells of a real compatibility matrix are not run: every application has now been loaded in Firefox and WebKit on Linux (cross-engine/), and TheHub started on macOS (qa/macos_observations.json), but nothing on Windows, Safari, or a phone. The browser floor rests on version numbers written from memory. No application has adopted the experience contract, so there is nothing to check contract compatibility against.

items: spiderweb-pr declares react, react-dom, vite and typescript as "latest". Its build is not reproducible from package.json alone; what it resolves to depends on its lockfile and the day it is installed.

skywatcher-pr is on React 18. aguayluz-pr, centinelas-pr, moneysweep-pr, ovnis-pr, thehub-pr and mucaro-ai are on React 19. spiderweb-pr declares "latest", so its version is not stated by its package.json. The shared package supports 18 and 19.
centinelas-pr is on Tailwind 3; aguayluz-pr, moneysweep-pr, ovnis-pr, skywatcher-pr and thehub-pr are on Tailwind 4. spiderweb-pr and mucaro-ai do not use Tailwind.

Design-system pins on main: thehub-pr source; moneysweep-pr 0.4.1; aguayluz-pr 0.4.0; centinelas-pr, ovnis-pr and skywatcher-pr 0.3.0; spiderweb-pr and mucaro-ai none. Nothing newer than 0.4.1 is released.
Desktop-runtime pins on main: five producers pin thehub-pr commit 1313c77, which predates the Launch Pad; spiderweb-pr pins f2b8176. The Launch Pad pins are on unmerged branches.
Python floors differ: thehub-pr >=3.9; aguayluz-pr, centinelas-pr and skywatcher-pr >=3.10; spiderweb-pr and mucaro-ai >=3.11; moneysweep-pr and ovnis-pr declare none in pyproject.toml.
Only thehub-pr and moneysweep-pr declare a Node engine.
CI names Firefox and WebKit for thehub-pr (design-system fixtures only), spiderweb-pr and, for WebKit, mucaro-ai. For the other five applications CI names Chromium only.

ASSUMPTION: from the features found in the builds, six applications need about Chromium 111, Firefox 128 and Safari 16.4; centinelas-pr and mucaro-ai about Chromium 111, Firefox 113 and Safari 16.2. The Firefox 128 figure comes from CSS @property and has not been checked against a compatibility source.

validation_against_rc2_schema.note: Planned, not possible. rc2/schemas/federation-compatibility.schema.json describes a declaration made by an application that has adopted the contract (it requires contract_version and its bounds). No application has, so no row can be a valid declaration. The matrix has its own shape instead; the gap is recorded here rather than filled with invented contract versions.

ci_jobs_confirmed_to_run_and_pass.note: Workflow files were read; run history was not.
